title: Drift: Decoding-time Personalized Alignments with Implicit User Preferences
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM personalization using a pool of attributes that include explicit ethical and moral frameworks such as Utilitarianism, Hedonism, and Deontology (under the 'Principled' attribute). It also includes a qualitative case study (Table 10) evaluating the model's response to a user query regarding the existence of God and conversations with a deity.
